findings.text: follow-on: at the reviewed head the refusal message and its test disagree. packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:259 raises MachineMapError(f"no bundle declares store root {name!r}") while tests/data/test_machine_map.py:391-392 still matches the pre-move wording 'description store root'. The head log quotes 'Expected regex: description store root' / 'Actual message: "no bundle declares store root \'NO_SUCH_STORE_ROOT\'"', and this review reproduced the same mismatch at the same file content (independent-repro-head.log, 2 failed EXIT=1). This is a genuine move-induced test/message mismatch, not an environment artefact; it sits in the jtfm-alambic-move write scope (test file not updated by the move), not in this measurement node's. No repair is requested of the reviewed node; recorded so the added_failure_count of 3 is not mistaken for a node defect.

follow-on: test_the_same_directory_reached_twice_is_one_bundle is environment-fragile. discover_bundles() always adds the installed imas_alambic.bundles entry point, and in the ambix environment exactly one is registered (MapBundle(name='ambix', version='1.0.0', machines=('mast','diii-d','jt-60sa'))), so the synthetic-map test sees 2 bundles where it asserts 1 ('assert 2 == 1'). The de-duplication of the doubled IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH entry itself works (one 'synth' bundle is returned). Reproduced independently (independent-repro-head.log). The test's assumption (no installed entry point) fails inside ambix's own environment; it belongs to the move/unlock nodes, not this measurement node.

follow-on: test_every_mast_map_range_is_one_geometry_transition is added to the head delta only as a -n 8 flake. The head log shows 'Failed: Timeout (>300.0s) from pytest-timeout' for it, and the reviewed run's head-mast-rerun.log shows it PASSES standalone at the same head in 108.44 s (EXIT=0). It was absent from the base FAILED set. The classification as a GPFS-contention flake rather than a head regression is sound; a per-test timeout above 300 s or a serial marker on the heavy description-inventory read would stabilise the gate so a future delta is not inflated by it.

follow_ons.text: Reconcile the store-root refusal message with its test in the jtfm-alambic-move write scope: either the test matches the new 'no bundle declares store root' wording or machine_map.py keeps 'description store root'. Raised by the reviewed run under follow_ons (a) and (b); this review confirms it reproduces at the same file content.

follow_ons.text: The synthetic-map dedup test must not assume an empty entry-point group; in ambix's synced environment the installed 'ambix' bundle makes discover_bundles() return 2. The move/unlock nodes own the entry-point wiring; the test should tolerate (or mock) the installed bundle. Not this node's scope.

follow_ons.text: Stabilise the heavy MAST description-inventory read: raise the per-test timeout above 300 s or mark it serial so the -n 8 gate does not time it out under GPFS contention. Recorded by the reviewed run under follow_ons (c).
